g.text: 1. System architecture: Five Doors, One Record
Every door writes the same Application; every provider role reads it through one service and one access guard.
every decision: actor, channel, on whose authority
mirrored into the spine on write
PART B: SEVEN PROVIDER ROLES (one login form, role-scoped views of the same record)
